card.summary: H.R. 7148, titled the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, became Public Law No. 119-75 on February 3, 2026. This federal law provides funding for the Department of Defense, Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, as well as Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and related agencies for fiscal year 2026. It also sets guidelines for the U.S. Sentencing Commission, extends various healthcare, Medicaid, Medicare, and trade programs, introduces pharmacy benefit management transparency rules, and awards a payment to the widow of a late representative.

summary: H.R. 4016 provides fiscal year 2026 appropriations for military activities of the Department of Defense, excluding military construction, family housing, Army Corps of Engineers civil works, and nuclear warheads. It sets funding for personnel, operation and maintenance, procurement, research and development, and revolving funds, while establishing strict administrative rules, restrictions, and reporting requirements.

affected_groups.effect: Receives pay, allowances, subsistence, clothing, travel expenses, and retirement fund contributions for active-duty, reserve, and National Guard members.
Subject to pay limitations, rules regarding contracting out functions, and prohibitions on funding for specific diversity, equity, and inclusion offices or plans.
Subject to domestic sourcing requirements like the Buy American Act, restrictions on arbitration agreements for sexual assault or civil rights claims, and various procurement allocations.

key_provisions: Provides fiscal year 2026 appropriations for military personnel across all branches, reserve components, and the National Guard.
Funds operation and maintenance accounts for the military branches, defense-wide activities, environmental restoration, and counter-drug programs.
Appropriates funds for weapons, ammunition, vehicle, aircraft, missile, and naval vessel procurement, including specific sub-allocations like the Columbia-class and Virginia-class submarines.
Allocates funds for basic and applied research, development, test, and evaluation (RDT&E) for the Army, Navy, Air Force, Space Force, and Defense-Wide.
Funds the Defense Health Program, chemical agents and munitions destruction, the Inspector General, intelligence community management, and the CIA retirement fund.
Sets general provisions restricting fund transfers, political activities, certain diversity programs, and the retirement or decommissioning of specific aircraft and naval vessels.

summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 4016 provides fiscal year 2026 appropriations for military activities of the Department of Defense, excluding military construction, family housing, Army Corps of Engineers civil works, and nuclear warheads. It sets funding for personnel, operation and maintenance, procurement, research and development, and revolving funds, while establishing strict administrative rules, restrictions, and reporting requirements.
summary_detail.significance: This legislation dictates the annual operational and capital budget for the U.S. military and intelligence-related activities for fiscal year 2026, shaping national defense priorities, equipment purchases, research initiatives, and statutory restrictions on federal funds.
